# filemanager_compare (Data Source)

Compares two files for equality across multiple dimensions including content, checksum, size, permissions, ownership, and modification time.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) Path to the source file.
- `target` (String) Path to the target file.

### Optional

- `checksum_algorithm` (String) Checksum algorithm: sha256, sha512. Defaults to sha256.
- `compare_checksum` (Boolean) Compare file checksums. Defaults to true.
- `compare_content` (Boolean) Compare file content byte-by-byte. Defaults to true.
- `compare_mode` (Boolean) Compare file permissions. Defaults to true.
- `compare_mtime` (Boolean) Compare modification times. Defaults to false.
- `compare_owner` (Boolean) Compare UID/GID ownership. Defaults to false.
- `compare_size` (Boolean) Compare file sizes. Defaults to true.
- `mtime_tolerance` (String) Tolerance for modification time comparison as Go duration (e.g., '5s', '1m'). Defaults to 0 (exact match).
- `source_backend` (String) Backend for source file. Defaults to local.
- `target_backend` (String) Backend for target file. Defaults to local.

### Read-Only

- `checksum_match` (Boolean) Checksum comparison result. Null if not compared.
- `content_match` (Boolean) Content comparison result. Null if not compared.
- `differences` (List of String) List of attributes that differ between source and target.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the data source.
- `identical` (Boolean) True if all enabled comparisons match.
- `mode_match` (Boolean) Permission mode comparison result. Null if not compared.
- `mtime_match` (Boolean) Modification time comparison result. Null if not compared.
- `owner_match` (Boolean) UID/GID comparison result. Null if not compared.
- `size_match` (Boolean) Size comparison result. Null if not compared.
- `source_checksum` (String) Checksum of source file.
- `source_exists` (Boolean) Whether the source file exists.
- `source_gid` (Number) GID of source file.
- `source_mode` (String) Permission mode of source file in octal.
- `source_mtime` (String) Modification time of source file in RFC3339 format.
- `source_size` (Number) Size of source file in bytes.
- `source_uid` (Number) UID of source file.
- `target_checksum` (String) Checksum of target file.
- `target_exists` (Boolean) Whether the target file exists.
- `target_gid` (Number) GID of target file.
- `target_mode` (String) Permission mode of target file in octal.
- `target_mtime` (String) Modification time of target file in RFC3339 format.
- `target_size` (Number) Size of target file in bytes.
- `target_uid` (Number) UID of target file.
